K.description: Convolution kernel size / cached window length (conv_L_cache).

description: LFM2-MoE decode-path depthwise causal conv1d update (kernel_size=3, no activation). The conv_state input holds the full K-wide window and is rolled/updated in place.
name: lfm2_moe_causal_conv1d_update
reference:
# Source: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/main/src/transformers/models/lfm2_moe/modeling_lfm2_moe.py (Lfm2MoeShortConv, causal_conv1d_update path)
import torch

def run(x, conv_state, weight, bias=None, activation=None):
    rolled = torch.cat([conv_state[..., 1:], x], dim=-1)
    out = (rolled * weight.unsqueeze(0)).sum(-1, keepdim=True)
    conv_state[..., 0] = conv_state[..., 1]
    conv_state[..., 1] = conv_state[..., 2]
    conv_state[..., 2] = x[..., 0]
    return out
